claim.en: Radoslav Bárta was elected to the Lastomír council in 2022 with 244 votes; he has been a councillor since 2018, working in energy.
claim.sk: Radoslav Bárta bol zvolený do OZ Lastomír v roku 2022 s 244 hlasmi; poslancom je od roku 2018, oblasť pôsobenia energetika.
